paper.title: Algorithm 851: CG_DESCENT, a conjugate gradient method with guaranteed descent

stack: Fortran 77 (TOMS 851 archive: Fortran/Dp/Src/src.f; Fortran/Dp/Drivers/driver1.f, data1, res1)

claim.text: driver1 (User's Guide example: n = 100, x = 1, grad_tol 1e-8, default cg.parm) prints cg iterations 32, function evaluations 55, gradient evaluations 45, as in the shipped res1; exact match (tolerance 0).

attempt: The authors' driver1.f compiled as its header documents (gfortran -O0 driver1.f src.f; cp data1 cg.parm; driver1 < data1) builds and runs with no change. The three integer counters match the shipped res1 exactly (32, 55, 45), in both passes (-O0 and -O2, separate trees). Not claimed and not matched exactly: the printed final gradient (0.8944D-08 here, 0.8963D-08 in res1) and the function value's print format (-653.07867273306204 here, -6.5307867273306158E+02 in res1; the same number to about 1e-12 relative). Both are below the 1e-8 stop tolerance or are formatting, and the claim excludes them by design.

original_attempt.reason: builds and runs as documented in driver1.f with gfortran 13 (conda-forge latest at fetch time); no source or flag change
